verdict: Linear: Choose Linear when product/engineering teams want a fast modern issue tracker — landscape beside Jira, not ranked as a monday/Asana Work OS peer. Scores use the project-management editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
weaknesses: Landscape-only on general PM best lists
tradeoffs: Seat minimums and AI credit bundles vs published per-seat floors
Work OS breadth vs specialist timeline / PDF / remote / desktop depth
Automation and reporting depth vs ease of use for small teams
Included AI credits vs paid AI add-ons or credit top-ups
recommendation: Choose Linear when product/engineering teams want a fast modern issue tracker — landscape beside Jira, not ranked as a monday/Asana Work OS peer. Compare Jira for enterprise Agile depth, ClickUp for cross-functional Work OS, and Height only if niche demand appears.
